snippet.title: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
1864, an uncharted island in the Arctic. Cabin boy Sam and his loyal husky Ellie find themselves stranded in the unforgiving cold in IKUMA - The Frozen Compass.

Explore the frozen wilderness, gather resources, uncover the mystery surrounding a lost expedition and rely on the unique abilities of both Sam and Ellie to survive. Play solo and switch between both characters, or experience their journey cooperatively with a friend.

Wishlist IKUMA - The Frozen Compass now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728620/IKUMA__The_Frozen_Compass/

Coming in 2026.
